notes.title: The Little Devil Update #1 is Live
notes.content:
Hello!
It's been a few days since the release of our third foklore and we really appreciate you for playing it and providing us with various feedback and bug reports. Through these feedback and reports, you are helping Pamali to become a better game for everyone. This update (build 3.6843) fixes various issues, adds enhancements and balancing;

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list][*] Some Fog intensities are lowered to produce a better visibility
[*] Various minor object interaction refinements
[*] Balanced some events and endings
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list][*] Depth of Field (Blur) Effect can now be disabled via 'DOF Camera' Option in the settings
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list][*] Fixed issued regarding objects related to ritual
[*] [spoiler]Disposable Camera[/spoiler] now can be taken properly
[*] Localization issues with some Jurig Board items are now fixed
[*] Fix issue with hospital's door during certain endings
[*] Collision on [spoiler]underground maze doors[/spoiler] are now disabled upon it being unlocked
[*] Various object interaction issues
[/list]

------
[b]Please read below if you experienced issues related to the inability to start the game or getting stuck on a blackscreen:[/b]
We received some reports that the game are not unable to run or experiencing blackscreen, we provided some solutions that can solve these issues in the end of this post. We apologize for the inconvenience. During our development of the third folklore we decided to upgrade our Unreal Engine due to a major bug and in hope for a better optimization. Unbeknown to us, upgrading the engine causes issues with the 'borderless fullscreen' feature that some players may already have activated on previous versions. Thus, to solve this issue you will need to disable this feature with one of these solutions below:

Solution 1 (Thanks to Goyang Dumang & Mr. John for helping us debug this issue):
1. Update to the latest version of the game.
2. Go to C:\Users[User Name]\AppData\Local\pjtRedLipstick_4p23\Saved\
3. Delete the 'Config' folder
4. Restart the game (do not activate the 'borderless fullscreen' option)

Solution 2 (Credits to ❆Marianne❆)
1. Right Click on Pamali on the Steam Launcher and select 'properties'
2. Go to the 'general' tab and  click on 'set launch options'
3. type in '-windowed' (without the quoation mark)
4. Run the game and go to the settings and make sure 'Borderless Fullscreen' is disabled

Please let us know if you are still experiencing the issue after trying out these solutions.
-----

Once again thank you for all your invaluable support and we apologize for the inconvenience. Aside from improving the experience of the third folklore, we are also currently working on the fourth folklore: The Hungry Witch and we will keep you posted on our future developments and updates.

Warmest regards,
StoryTale Studios

notes.title: The Tied Corpse First Update is Live & a Little Sneak Peek!
notes.content:
Hello!
First of all, we’d like to say thank you for all the feedback and bug reports you have provided us for Pamali's second folklore: [b]The Tied Corpse[/b]. Through these feedback and reports, you are helping Pamali to become a better game for everyone. This update (build 2.5928) fixes various issues, adds enhancements and balancing for both the second and the first folklore as well.

Here are the changes and the improvements that are made:

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some level collisions have been improved to prevent player getting stuck
[*] Radio volumes are now louder during rain
[*] Various minor object interaction refinements
[*] Balanced some events and endings
[/list]

[b]Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*] A 'play build' feature is added and is accessible if all endings have been unlocked
[*] A new grading system that grades your gravekeeping actions upon reaching an ending on the second folklore
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Light on certain endings that are previously off is now turned on (ending 5,7,9,11)
[*] Duplicated objects are removed
[*] Issues on ghosts' skeletal form is fixed
[*] All phone calls are now accessible
[*] Death Log can now be interacted multiple times 
[*] Some phone calls timings and dialogues are refined
[/list]

Once again thank you for all your invaluable support. We are also currently working on the third folklore: [b]The Little Devil[/b] and we will keep you posted on our future developments and updates.

Warmest regards,
[b]StoryTale Studios[/b]

notes.title: Pamali: Indonesian Folklore Horror - DLCs Development Update
notes.content:
Hi, this is StoryTale Studios.


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BXluQpK9Egk&feature=youtu.be


It’s been three months since the release of The White Lady. We really appreciate all the support and the amazing responses and feedbacks we get. All the feedbacks gave us new perspectives and paved the ways for us to improve the game, including the DLC that we’re currently developing: The Tied Corpse.

From all the feedbacks that we get, we have learned that the game has the potential to bring richer and more flavorful storytelling and horror experience. We also need to have a more thorough QA process to ensure that we can deliver a more polished product.

In order to achieve them, while keeping the initial timeline on The Tied Corpse and other DLCs, we have been crunching, working around the clock because the scope of our game has become bigger than expected. However, we realize along the way that as a small team, the development hours and schedule has not been healthy as it has been taking a toll on us and the product.

Therefore, after a thorough consideration, we have decided to [b]delay the releases of all Pamali DLCs and move the release date of The Tied Corpse to May 14, 2019.[/b]

We deeply apologize for the inconvenience it may cause.

Despite the challenges, developing Pamali for you is still our topmost priority and we are still aiming to release all the DLCs by this year.

We sincerely appreciate all the support and thank you for your understanding. We can’t wait to give you the experience of Indonesian folklore horror through Pamali.


Any feedbacks or questions regarding Pamali: Indonesian Folklore Horror could be sent to:
Discord: https://discordapp.com/invite/UCZUjqm
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/pamaligame/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/pamaligame/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/StoryTaleDev



Kind regards,

StoryTale Studios.

notes.title: The White Lady update #1 is live
notes.content:
Hello!
Thank you very much for your supportive feedbacks for Pamali's first folklore: The White Lady. We also appreciate your bug reports for these past days. By reporting bugs, you are helping Pamali to become a better game for everyone.
This update (build 1.4522) fixes various issues, adds enhancements and balancing for The White Lady folklore based on your feedbacks. Here are the changes and the improvements that are made:

[b]Changes:[/b]
-Balanced events on Night 2 and Night 3
-Balanced some endings
-Modified light flicker sound range
-Some left choice and speech translations are improved and fixed
-"F-Translate" icon is disabled if the current localization is in Bahasa Indonesia
-Increased maxiumum gamma setting, so player can brighten up the game even more
-Modified post process exposure to brightness

[b]Additions:[/b]
-Zoom (mouse scroll) tutorial icon added to object interaction HUD
-An object ([spoiler]Baby Doll[/spoiler]) is now can manually be placed [spoiler]on the offering place[/spoiler] if its already in inventory

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
-Fixed cleaning bug where it might be detected as dirty on clean spots
-Fixed an ending where it might be triggered together with other endings

Once again thank you for all your invaluable support. We are now working on the second folklore: The Tied Corpse. We are very excited to share the second folklore soon!

Warmest regards,
StoryTale Studios
